doc.title: Toshiko Akiyoshi interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999

title: Keeping the band together
summary: The band survives because musicians want to play her music despite little pay.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well this has just been a fascinating conversation. I hope that the band stays together.
I know it must be, with all those people, a difficult proposition, to keep a corps of—

Yes. A band like mine can’t exist without the musicians, every musician wants to belong to the band, that wants to play this music. Other than that it cannot exist. Because it’s very little monetary reward. So I think I’m very lucky. Also musicians like to gather with good musicians. That’s another thing.
